name: Volara
tagline: Turn your drone into a proper inspection tool.
positioning: Volara helps homeowners and independent operators plan flights, tag defects, and generate clean inspection reports from consumer drone footage.

hero.h1: Inspect your roof without ever touching a ladder.
hero.sub: Volara turns the drone you already own into a real inspection tool — guided flights, tagged defects, and a report you can hand to your insurer or contractor.

features.title: Guided flight paths
features.description: Draw your roof or panel array once and Volara plans an overlapping capture pattern, so you never miss a slope, valley, or vent.

features.title: Tag defects as you go
features.description: Drop pins on cracked shingles, loose flashing, or rust and add a note. Every tag lands on the map and in the report automatically.

features.title: Reports in minutes
features.description: Volara stitches your stills into a dated, location-stamped PDF that insurers and roofers actually accept — no editing software required.

features.title: Know your weather window
features.description: We watch wind speed and light for your exact address and tell you the next safe two-hour window to fly.

features.title: Everything stays organized
features.description: Each property gets its own timeline, so last spring's inspection sits right next to today's — easy to compare year over year.

features.title: Share with one link
features.description: Send a read-only link to a contractor or a claims adjuster. They see the photos, tags, and notes without an account.

testimonials.quote: I flew my roof after a hailstorm, tagged the dented vents in ten minutes, and my adjuster approved the claim off the Volara report. I never went up the ladder once.
testimonials.name: Dana Reinhardt

testimonials.quote: I inspect solar arrays as a side business. Volara's flight paths give me consistent overlap every time, so my thermal stills line up cleanly in the report.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ospina

testimonials.quote: Before a listing I fly the roof and gutters and drop the report into the disclosure packet. Buyers trust it because every photo is dated and geotagged.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh

pricing.blurb: For the occasional inspection of your own property.
For frequent flyers and side-business operators.

homepage.footerBlurb: Volara helps individuals and independent operators fly smarter and document what they find — one clean inspection report at a time.
